aries:
♈ Aries

🔥 Energy: Today the Sun and Moon are tightly together in Leo in Purva Phalguni and early Uttara Phalguni, your 5th house from Aries. This gives the day a strong creative and expressive pulse, but with Ketu also in Leo there’s a karmic edge around how you seek attention and pleasure. Mars, your ruler, is still in Gemini in Punarvasu in your 3rd house, keeping your hands and mind busy with messages, errands and quick decisions. Saturn retrograde in Pisces sits in your 12th, quietly asking you to notice where rest, surrender and solitude are overdue.

💼 Career: The 5th–3rd house emphasis favours projects where originality and communication meet: pitching ideas, teaching, content creation, or anything that requires you to put your personal stamp on information. You may feel a push to take a calculated risk—suggesting a new approach, volunteering for a visible task, or experimenting with a bolder style in your work. Just avoid scattering your efforts; Mars in Gemini can make you start three things and finish none. Choose one idea that genuinely excites you and move it one concrete step forward.

❤️ Love: Romance has a playful yet fated quality. The Leo stellium in your 5th heightens attraction, flirtation, and the desire to be noticed. If partnered, you might crave more fun and spontaneous affection than usual; plan something that feels like a date, not just shared logistics. Old patterns in how you seek validation could surface—notice if you test your partner’s love by stirring drama rather than asking directly for warmth. If single, someone expressive or artistic could catch your attention; stay curious but pace yourself, as Ketu can revive old karmic scripts for closure, not necessarily for long-term bonding.

💰 Money: The focus is less on heavy financial moves and more on how you use resources to fuel joy. Spending on hobbies, children, or creative tools is likely, and can be worthwhile if it genuinely feeds your talents. Be mindful of “ego expenses” meant to prove something to others. With Jupiter strong in Cancer in your 4th, investments that improve emotional security and home life still carry more lasting benefit than showy pleasures.

🧘 Advice: Let your fire express itself through one honest, wholehearted act instead of many half-hearted gestures. When your enthusiasm is focused, it becomes magnetic rather than draining.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The stage that matters most today isn’t the one in front of others—it’s the one where you finally see your own gifts clearly.
taurus:
♉ Taurus

🔥 Energy: With the Sun, Moon and Ketu clustered in Leo in late Purva Phalguni/early Uttara Phalguni, your 4th house, the spotlight turns inward toward home, roots and emotional foundations. Venus, your ruler, moves through early Libra in Chitra in your 6th house, refining your daily work and health patterns with a desire for balance and aesthetics. Jupiter strong in Cancer in Ashlesha activates your 3rd, expanding learning, local connections and communication, while Saturn retrograde in Pisces in your 11th asks you to take long-term friendships and goals more seriously.

💼 Career: Today favours behind-the-scenes strengthening of your base rather than loud moves. You may feel drawn to adjust your workspace, schedule or remote-working setup so that it actually supports your wellbeing. Venus in the 6th helps you smooth over small frictions with colleagues and make routines more graceful—organising your desk, streamlining processes, or negotiating a fairer division of tasks. Jupiter in your 3rd encourages reaching out: a thoughtful message or short meeting can open a door, especially with people you already know.

❤️ Love: The 4th-house Leo emphasis makes you extra sensitive to how “at home” you feel with others. If partnered, shared domestic themes—comfort, family dynamics, living arrangements—may come into focus. You might realise that something in your environment no longer reflects who you are as a couple: décor, routines, or even the way you handle private disagreements. If single, your heart may lean toward people who feel emotionally familiar or who share some piece of your background. Don’t ignore the subtle bodily sense of ease or tension you feel around them; your instincts are sharper than usual.

💰 Money: Home-related expenses or planning can arise now—repairs, furniture, or thoughts of moving. This is a favourable day for comparing options, clarifying rental or mortgage terms, and mapping a realistic savings track for a domestic goal. Venus in Libra also highlights the cost of everyday comfort: subscriptions, convenience services, small luxuries. Rather than cutting everything, refine: keep what genuinely nourishes you and drop what only fills space.

🧘 Advice: Take your desire for comfort seriously, not as laziness but as information about what your nervous system needs to feel safe enough to grow.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The way you arrange your space today quietly teaches your heart what kind of life it’s allowed to expect.
gemini:
♊ Gemini

🔥 Energy: The Sun–Moon conjunction with Ketu in Leo occupies your 3rd house, making today mentally bright, communicative and somewhat karmic around siblings, neighbours and speech. Mars in your own sign (sidereal Gemini) in Punarvasu supercharges your restlessness, while Mercury, your ruler, has slipped into early Virgo in Uttara Phalguni in your 4th, adding a practical, discerning tone to decisions about home and family. Jupiter in Cancer in Ashlesha continues to strengthen your 2nd house of resources and values.

💼 Career: Communication-heavy tasks are highlighted: writing, calls, presenting, sales, and quick problem-solving. You may feel compelled to voice an opinion you’ve held back, or to reframe an idea so people finally “get it.” Mars in your sign lends courage but can also sharpen your tongue; use your edge to be clear, not cutting. Mercury in the 4th suggests that well-thought-out planning done in a quiet corner—structuring files, reorganising projects, mapping timelines—can make your outward moves more effective.

❤️ Love: Conversations today can either connect or trigger, depending on how consciously you use your words. If partnered, small discussions about plans, errands or even light topics can unexpectedly tap into deeper themes about how heard each of you feels. Listen for what’s underneath the practical details. If single, you could encounter someone intriguing through your neighbourhood, a short course, or online chat. Mental spark will be strong, but watch for repeating patterns—Ketu in your 3rd can bring back familiar types so you can finally respond differently.

💰 Money: Jupiter active in your 2nd continues to open opportunities to stabilise and gently grow your income, often through skills you already have but haven’t fully owned. The 3rd-house activation suggests that small side projects, tutoring, consulting, or content work could become viable if you take them seriously. Review your daily spending on transport, apps and quick buys; many tiny leaks may equal one larger bill.

🧘 Advice: Don’t let every passing thought turn into action or speech. Today your power lies in choosing which ideas deserve your full voice.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The sentence you edit before saying out loud may change the whole direction of a relationship.
cancer:
♋ Cancer

🔥 Energy: The Sun–Moon union in late Leo in Purva/Uttara Phalguni with Ketu nearby activates your 2nd house of livelihood, speech and self-worth. Jupiter dignified in your own sign Cancer in Ashlesha continues to amplify your presence and intuition, while Mars in Gemini in Punarvasu energises your 12th-house subconscious and dream life. Saturn retrograde in Pisces in your 9th keeps asking for serious engagement with beliefs, study or spiritual practice.

💼 Career: Questions about how your work reflects your value may rise to the surface. You might feel an urge to renegotiate pay, refine your pricing, or shift toward roles where your natural caring and strategic sense are better recognised. With Jupiter in your 1st, others often see you as a problem-solver or mentor now; just avoid overextending to prove your worth. Mars in the 12th can make you restless or drained if you push too hard—build in short, genuine breaks so that your empathy doesn’t turn into fatigue.

❤️ Love: In relationships, the way you and your partner talk about money, time and appreciation becomes important. If partnered, you may notice where you give more quietly than you receive, or where pride keeps you from expressing a need. Honest, non-accusatory conversations about contributions—both practical and emotional—can actually deepen warmth. If single, you may feel drawn to people who seem confident or generous; look beyond surface status to whether they truly see and respect your sensitivity.

💰 Money: This 2nd-house Leo focus can bring both earning opportunities and temptations to spend for comfort or prestige. You might consider an upgrade—tools, wardrobe, training—that genuinely supports your long-term path. Weigh each expense against the feeling of inner stability it brings. With Rahu in Aquarius in your 8th, be discerning around shared finances, loans or sudden offers that promise quick gains; clarity and patience serve you better than urgency.

🧘 Advice: Anchor your generosity in self-respect. When you treat your own resources as finite and precious, others learn to do the same.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Every “yes” you give today—of time, money or care—is also a silent statement about what you think you’re worth.
leo:
♌ Leo

🔥 Energy: The Sun and Moon are conjunct in your own sign Leo in late Purva Phalguni/early Uttara Phalguni, and Ketu is also travelling through Leo. This places your identity, body and direction under a bright yet introspective light. You’re in a subtle reset phase, not the loud, showy kind, but the kind where you quietly edit what no longer belongs in your self-image. Jupiter in Cancer in your 12th expands your inner world, dreams and need for retreat, while Saturn retrograde in Pisces in your 8th keeps deep emotional and trust themes active.

💼 Career: You may feel strongly that something about how you show up professionally must evolve. This could look like adjusting your public persona, letting go of a role that feels too small, or deciding to carry yourself with more calm authority rather than constant performance. With your 1st and 12th both lit, private planning is powerful: refining your goals, closing old chapters, clearing digital or physical clutter that keeps you tied to outdated versions of yourself. Don’t rush into grand announcements; let the inner decision ripen first.

❤️ Love: Your relationships mirror the shifts in your sense of self. If partnered, you might sense that the old “role” you’ve played—always the strong one, the entertainer, the generous giver—is ready for an update. Honest sharing about who you’re becoming can feel vulnerable but healing. If single, you may feel both magnetic and strangely selective. Ketu in your sign can attract people linked to past karmas; notice whether connections feel like repetition or genuine evolution.

💰 Money: Financially, today invites you to separate genuine needs from image-based spending. You might recognise that certain expenses served an old identity more than your current priorities. This is a good day to quietly simplify: cancel something that no longer feels aligned, or redirect funds toward a future plan that actually excites you. With Jupiter in the 12th, money spent on inner growth, rest or healing can bring returns that aren’t immediately visible but are deeply stabilising.

🧘 Advice: Allow yourself to be in-between versions. You don’t need to explain every change; you just need to live the next truthful step.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The most important audience for your transformation right now is not the world, but the part of you that finally believes it’s allowed to change.
virgo:
♍ Virgo

🔥 Energy: The Sun, Moon and Ketu are gathered in Leo in your 12th house, stirring dreams, buried feelings and the urge to withdraw from noise. At the same time Mercury, your ruler, has just entered your own sign Virgo in Uttara Phalguni, giving you rare clarity and discrimination about what truly serves you. Jupiter in Cancer in your 11th house supports wise friendships and long-range aspirations, while Saturn retrograde in Pisces in your 7th asks for sober reflection about key partnerships.

💼 Career: Outwardly, this may not be the loudest career day, but inwardly it’s strategic. You’re well-positioned to review where your energy actually goes: which tasks drain you, which patterns at work you keep repeating out of guilt or habit, and which alliances genuinely support your growth. Mercury in your sign helps you separate useful self-criticism from unnecessary harshness. Use this to refine your role description—even if only in your own mind—so that future choices align better with your strengths.

❤️ Love: The 12th–7th emphasis can bring subtle relationship insights via dreams, chance thoughts or quiet moments. If partnered, you may feel old disappointments or unspoken fears surface; instead of pushing them away, approach gently and name what you’re feeling without blaming. Honest but measured conversation can lift a fog. If single, you might be drawn to more private or mysterious connections—people met in spiritual, artistic or healing spaces. Trust the slow pace; not every intense pull is meant to be rushed into.

💰 Money: Hidden expenses or vague financial arrangements could come into clearer focus. This is a favourable day to review subscriptions, shared payments or lingering small debts and quietly close what’s no longer needed. With Jupiter in the 11th, a friend or network contact may offer helpful information about savings, investments or fairer compensation. Take advice, but run it through your own analytical filter before acting.

🧘 Advice: Honour your need for solitude as productive time, not a luxury. Your best decisions now are born in the quiet spaces you often skip.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you stop apologising for needing space, you finally have room to make choices you don’t regret.
libra:
♎ Libra

🔥 Energy: The Sun–Moon conjunction with Ketu in Leo lights up your 11th house of friendships, communities and long-term hopes. Venus, your ruler, is moving through early Libra in Chitra in your 1st house, enhancing your charm, aesthetic sense and desire to present yourself authentically. Jupiter strong in Cancer in your 10th continues to widen your professional horizons, while Saturn retrograde in Pisces in your 6th keeps urging you toward more disciplined work and health habits.

💼 Career: Networks, clients and public perception are key themes today. You might receive invitations, ideas or feedback through friends, online groups or professional circles. Venus in your sign helps you negotiate gracefully and present your work in a more polished way—updating a profile, refining a portfolio, or showing up visibly in a community where your skills matter. At the same time, Ketu in the 11th helps you discern which alliances are truly aligned with your path and which you’re keeping out of habit or fear of missing out.

❤️ Love: Social and romantic currents can intertwine. If partnered, doing something with shared friends or working together toward a mutual long-term dream can feel nourishing. If you’ve been leaning too much on collective approval, today may show you where the relationship needs its own private rules. If single, you could encounter someone through group activities, social media or collaborative projects. Notice who consistently remembers your values and boundaries, not just who shines in public.

💰 Money: Gains or opportunities may come through your network—referrals, collaborations or tips about roles that suit your skills. This is a good time to clarify what you actually want to work toward financially over the next few years so you can recognise relevant doors when they open. Saturn in your 6th insists on realistic daily structure; big goals require small, repeatable steps, not just inspiration.

🧘 Advice: Be selective about where you invest your social energy. The right community should leave you clearer about yourself, not more confused.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Every room you choose to walk into now is a quiet vote for the future version of you that you’re willing to grow into.
scorpio:
♏ Scorpio

🔥 Energy: The Sun, Moon and Ketu together in Leo occupy your 10th house of career, reputation and visible responsibilities. This puts your public role under review. Mars, your traditional ruler, is in Gemini in Punarvasu in your 8th house, activating deep processes around shared resources, vulnerability and old psychological patterns. Jupiter in Cancer in your 9th continues to stretch your worldview through study, mentorship or spiritual exploration, while Saturn retrograde in Pisces in your 5th tests your creative and romantic commitments.

💼 Career: This is a potent day for examining what success actually means to you now. You may feel pushed into the spotlight through a task, decision or evaluation, or you may simply realise that the external image you project doesn’t fully match your inner direction anymore. With Ketu in your 10th, you’re being nudged to release outdated ambitions or titles and to focus on work that feels meaningful, not just impressive. Mars in the 8th supports concentrated effort on complex issues—contracts, budgets, strategy—so long as you avoid sliding into control battles.

❤️ Love: The mix of 10th and 8th house activity can make your partner or close connections feel the ripple of your career concerns. If partnered, sharing honestly about the pressures or doubts you’re facing at work can bring you closer, especially if you’re willing to discuss how those choices affect both of you. If single, you may feel drawn to intense, magnetic people you meet through professional or educational settings. Take your time; depth is good, but watch for imbalances of power or emotional transparency.

💰 Money: Joint finances, debts or long-term financial commitments may require attention now. Use today’s focus to clarify terms, check whether current arrangements are truly fair, and decide where you’re ready to set firmer boundaries. With Jupiter in the 9th, expert guidance—financial or legal—can be especially helpful if you’re open to learning rather than trying to manage everything alone.

🧘 Advice: Let your ambition be filtered through integrity. You’re most powerful when your outer moves match the inner truths you’ve already faced.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The reputation that will last is the one built on choices you’re not afraid to remember later.
sagittarius:
♐ Sagittarius

🔥 Energy: The Sun–Moon conjunction with Ketu in Leo falls in your 9th house of belief, higher learning, travel and purpose, making today a crossroads for your philosophy of life. Jupiter, your ruler, is strong in Cancer in Ashlesha in your 8th house, pushing you toward emotional honesty and transformative intimacy. Mars in Gemini in your 7th activates one-to-one dynamics, sometimes sharply, while Saturn retrograde in Pisces in your 4th continues to reshape your understanding of home and roots.

💼 Career: Big-picture questions are louder than daily details right now. You may sense that your work needs to align more clearly with your ethics or desire for growth. This is an excellent time to research courses, certifications or new fields that expand your options, or to revisit a teaching, publishing or international idea that was put on hold. Mars in the 7th can bring negotiations or disagreements with partners or clients; try to keep debates about ideas, not about egos.

❤️ Love: Your desire for relationships that support your growth is heightened. If partnered, you might initiate conversations about future plans, shared values or spiritual interests. Differences in belief or background could surface; see them as invitations to understand one another more deeply rather than as threats. If single, you may be drawn to people from different cultures, or to those met in academic, spiritual or travel contexts. Pay attention to who encourages your honest self-inquiry instead of just your adventurous side.

💰 Money: With Jupiter in the 8th and the 9th activated, financial matters are tied closely to trust and worldview. You could be prompted to reassess loans, investments or shared financial responsibilities, asking whether they genuinely support your long-term freedom. It’s a good day to seek advice, read, or learn about money topics you’ve postponed—taxes, wills, or debt plans—so that your choices rest on understanding rather than avoidance.

🧘 Advice: Let questions guide you more than quick answers. Real clarity about your path will come from patiently sitting with what no longer resonates.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The belief you quietly retire today frees up energy you didn’t know was trapped in keeping it alive.
capricorn:
♑ Capricorn

🔥 Energy: The Sun, Moon and Ketu clustered in Leo light up your 8th house of intimacy, shared resources, psychological depths and endings. Saturn, your ruler, is retrograde in Pisces in your 3rd, insisting on mature, measured communication. Jupiter in Cancer in Ashlesha occupies your 7th, magnifying the importance of key partnerships, while Mars in Gemini in Punarvasu energises your 6th house of work and health routines.

💼 Career: Under this 8th–6th activation, hidden layers of work—budgets, power dynamics, behind-the-scenes negotiations—come into focus. It’s a strong day for reviewing contracts, clarifying who is responsible for what, and handling sensitive information with discretion. Mars in the 6th gives you stamina to tackle tasks you’ve avoided, but pace yourself and avoid taking on extra burdens just to feel in control. Collaborations can deepen now if you’re willing to be direct about expectations and limits.

❤️ Love: Emotional depth is highlighted, sometimes through small triggers rather than dramatic events. If partnered, topics like trust, past hurts, or how you share responsibilities may resurface. Approach them with a blend of honesty and gentleness; your instinct might be to shut down or to rationalise, but real connection asks for emotional presence. If single, you may feel drawn to complex, introspective people or to connections where vulnerability is possible. Take it slowly; the 8th house wants gradual unveiling, not instant merging.

💰 Money: Shared finances, taxes, inheritances or joint debts may need attention. Use today to make an inventory of what is truly shared and what is yours alone, and to check whether current arrangements feel fair. With Jupiter blessing your 7th, a partner, advisor or even a client may offer supportive insight if you’re open to it. Avoid big impulsive financial moves; focus instead on cleaning up, clarifying and simplifying existing ties.

🧘 Advice: When intensity rises, resist the urge to handle everything silently. Saying “this is hard for me” is not weakness—it’s an opening.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The courage to name what you’ve been silently carrying is the first step in no longer carrying it alone.
aquarius:
♒ Aquarius

🔥 Energy: The Sun–Moon conjunction with Ketu in Leo stands directly opposite you in the 7th house, bringing partnerships, clients and close one-to-one connections into sharp relief. Rahu in Aquarius in Dhanishtha sits in your own sign, amplifying your desire for independence and experimentation. Saturn, your traditional ruler, is retrograde in Pisces in your 2nd, quietly restructuring your relationship with money and self-worth, while Jupiter in Cancer in your 6th encourages growth through service and skill-building.

💼 Career: Collaboration dynamics are centre stage. You may be dealing with key counterparts—bosses, clients, co-founders—with heightened clarity about what is and isn’t working. Ketu in the 7th can reveal where you’ve been over-accommodating or emotionally distant. Conversations about expectations, boundaries and shared goals are timely, especially if you ground them in facts rather than frustration. Jupiter in the 6th supports upgrading systems and workflows, possibly with help from someone more experienced.

❤️ Love: Relationship mirrors are strong now. If partnered, you’re likely to see more clearly how your patterns—detachment, idealism, or sudden need for space—impact the bond. This isn’t about blame, but about understanding the dance you’re both in. Honest, face-to-face dialogue can reset things, particularly if you’re willing to express needs before resentment builds. If single, magnetic, confident people may appear, but pay attention to whether there is room for your individuality or if you’re being cast into a fixed role.

💰 Money: Saturn in your 2nd keeps nudging you toward financial realism: living within your means, building reserves slowly, and aligning spending with core values. Because the 7th is activated, negotiations around pay, contracts or shared expenses could arise. Aim for arrangements that reflect your actual contributions and protect your time. With Rahu in your 1st, avoid impulsive financial decisions made purely to assert independence or difference.

🧘 Advice: See the people close to you as reflections, not enemies or saviours. What bothers or inspires you in them often points to something important in yourself.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The boundary you calmly explain today can change how every future connection experiences you.
pisces:
♓ Pisces

🔥 Energy: The Sun–Moon–Ketu combination in Leo activates your 6th house of work, health and daily habits, pulling attention to how you manage effort and self-care. Saturn retrograde in your own sign Pisces continues to refine your identity through responsibility and boundaries. Jupiter, your traditional ruler, is strong in Cancer in your 5th, supporting creativity, affection and connection with children or passion projects. Mars in Gemini in Punarvasu energises your 4th, stirring activity around home and inner emotional patterns.

💼 Career: This is a constructive day for refining how you work rather than just how much you work. You may feel more aware of which tasks truly matter and which are busywork you’ve accepted out of guilt. Ketu in the 6th encourages dropping unhelpful perfectionism and obligations that drain you without real purpose. Small, practical improvements—clearer schedules, better boundaries with colleagues, realistic to-do lists—can have outsized impact. Jupiter in the 5th reminds you that bringing some play and creativity into your job actually increases productivity.

❤️ Love: Practical concerns mingle with emotional needs. If partnered, conversations about chores, schedules or health routines may come up; handled with kindness, they can actually deepen support rather than feel like criticism. You might also notice where you mother or rescue your partner at the expense of your own energy. If single, you could meet potential partners in work or wellness spaces, or through responsibilities connected to children or hobbies. Look for people who respect your sensitivity as a strength, not something to manage.

💰 Money: The 6th house links finances to daily choices. Today is favourable for reviewing how your habits influence your earning capacity and financial stability—time management, focus, rest and even diet. Modest investments in tools or training that make your work smoother or more enjoyable can pay off over time. With Saturn in your 1st, avoid taking on financial promises you can’t sustain just to be kind; sustainable generosity begins with honest limits.

🧘 Advice: Treat your routines as an act of compassion toward your future self, not as punishment for who you are now.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The quiet, repeatable choices you make today will shape the kind of life your intuition has been trying to lead you toward.
